criteria.title: Impact & Value
questions: Does the solution offer tangible benefits to the business?
Does the team describe the success of their solution using metrics, goals, outcomes, or cause and effects?
What is the potential reach and significance of the solution?

criteria.title: Innovation & Creativity
questions: Does the solution effectively leverage Google technology in a creative way?
Does the solution offer a new approach or perspective to the problem?

criteria.title: Communication & Presentation
questions: Is the solution explained in a clear, concise, and understandable manner?
Are diagrams, mockups, or prototypes used effectively?
How well is the solution presented? Is it persuasive and engaging?

criteria.title: Feasibility & Functionality
questions: How well does the solution actually solve the stated problem?
Can the solution be realistically implemented with available technology?
Is the technical implementation well-executed with proper coding, design, and architecture?
Does the solution optimize resources (time, cost, labor)?

rulesTieBreak: Section 6: a tie goes to the entry with the higher score in “Impact & Value” “Innovation & Creativity” (printed without a conjunction).
